mapper.insert: INSERT INTO openbiz_shop_order (tenant_id, buyer_name, buyer_phone, total_amount, status, idempotent_key, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{buyerName}, #{buyerPhone}, #{totalAmount}, #{status}, #{idempotentKey}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, buyer_name, buyer_phone, total_amount, status, idempotent_key, create_time, update_time FROM openbiz_shop_order WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} LIMIT 1
